reuse_rule: Reuse G8 translations exactly for all 93 JEI key/value pairs because the pinned English source is byte-identical.
new_selected_realization: The eight newly selected real-world languages use documented complete English fallbacks in G9 rather than low-confidence invented technical translations. They remain selected and can be replaced by reviewed translations later without changing ownership.
supplement_reuse_policy: Reuse exact G8 project supplement values for unchanged missing keys. ja_jp is now complete upstream and emits no addon file. sv_se lost four upstream translations; recover those exact values from the pinned G8 upstream file instead of falling back to English.
debug_keys: Keep target English values for debug-only description.jei.* entries in full addon files; never add debug-only keys to supplements.
norwegian_policy: Minecraft-facing no_no remains a full addon locale. JEI nb_no is preserved independently and is not treated as an alias.
release_rule: Minecraft 1.12 must receive its own dedicated JAR; never combine it with Minecraft 1.12.1, 1.12.2 or another version.
